messages.start: Start a countdown. data: {seconds: whole number 1..5999}. Replies {state, remaining} in seconds.
messages.pause: Pause a running countdown. Replies {state, remaining} in seconds.
messages.resume: Resume a paused countdown. Replies {state, remaining} in seconds.
messages.reset: Stop and clear the countdown (also silences the alarm). Replies {state, remaining} in seconds.
messages.status: Change nothing. Replies {state, remaining} in seconds; state is idle, running, paused or done.
